aboutGame.title: What is Animal Hospital?
paragraphs: **Animal Hospital** is a Roblox horror-survival game where you work the night shift at a hospital treating animal patients — some of whom aren't what they appear to be.
Players rotate through hospital rooms completing tasks, while staying alert for anomalies hiding among ordinary patients.

extraSections.title: Animal Hospital Anomalies
